From soil to flame

The best stories start at the table.

Our kitchen follows the seasons and the market. We bring familiar East African flavours into a lively, modern meal—slow-cooked, flame-kissed, and always meant to be shared.

Gather well. Eat well.

We believe a good table makes space for everyone. Drop in for a quick lunch, bring the whole family, or let the evening stretch into another round.
